mapper.sql: select draft_id, process_key, process_name, form_id, title, start_user_id, start_user_name, start_nick_name, dept_id, create_time, update_time from flow_draft
mapper.insert: insert into flow_draft ( process_key, process_name, form_id, title, form_data, start_user_id, start_user_name, start_nick_name, dept_id, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{processKey}, #{processName}, #{formId}, #{title}, #{formData}, #{startUserId}, #{startUserName}, #{startNickName}, #{deptId}, sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.delete: delete from flow_draft where start_user_id = #{startUserId} and process_key = #{processKey}
